question: At the same target error among notes pre-filled for one-click confirmation, does adding an independent judge let more notes be pre-filled than the student's own confidence?

student.rule: highest validation exact match; prefer the pre-registered primary of compare-v1.json when it and the highest run lie within each other's Wilson 95% intervals; test results are never read for the choice
student.why: highest validation exact match is C-270m-all-v2data (134/310); the pre-registered primary V3-270m-nemotron (124/310) and it lie within each other's Wilson 95% intervals, so the rule prefers the primary

design.threshold_rule: on validation notes only: accept a note when its score >= t; t is the value with the largest validation coverage whose observed error among accepted notes is <= the target, with at least 20 accepted notes; otherwise no threshold is set
design.empirical_not_guaranteed: the thresholds are chosen on 310 synthetic validation notes (the subset ones on fewer); the error on new notes can be higher
design.coverage_denominator: every note in the set, including notes whose prediction did not parse (they always go to a person)

signals.student: mean token log-probability of the student's answer (higher = more confident)
signals.jev: judge score from Jev: min over predicted events of P(event stated) x (1 - P(unlisted event)); 0 when Jev's route choice differs from the student's route
signals.decisions: the same judge score from OpenAI Decisions (question set v1), on the subset only
signals.student+jev: ridge logistic regression of exact match on (student, jev), fitted on validation notes
signals.student+jev+decisions: ridge logistic regression on (student, jev, decisions), fitted on the validation part of the subset
signals.student@subset: student confidence alone with its threshold re-chosen on the validation part of the subset (like-for-like control)

design.leak_guard: assert_validation_only() raises before any fit or threshold sees a note whose split is not 'val' or whose id is a test id; unit-tested in scribe/v3/tests/test_cascade.py
design.bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap over test notes, 2000 resamples, seed '20261114|<section>|<set>'; thresholds held fixed, so it omits the noise of choosing them (see pipeline_bootstrap)

decisions_subset.order: sha256('scribe-v3-cascade-decisions|' + id) ascending, within validation and within the pooled test notes
decisions_subset.size_rule: largest K <= 120 per split whose estimated tokens stay <= 270000 (90% of the 300000 cap)
decisions_subset.estimate: ceil(characters of the JSON request body x the maximum tokens-per-character over the cached benchmark Decisions requests)

design.unparsed: notes whose prediction did not parse are not sent to a judge and are never accepted by any signal

student+jev.note: weights are on standardised features (mean/sd of the fitting notes); the cascade ranks by the linear predictor

student+jev+decisions.note: weights are on standardised features (mean/sd of the fitting notes); the cascade ranks by the linear predictor

pipeline_bootstrap.note: validation and test resampled together; logistic fit and thresholds re-chosen each time; pooled test; a resample without a feasible threshold counts as coverage 0 and has no error

cost.price: USD 0.042 per million tokens (input + output), owner's price in scribe/judges/core.py
cost.latency_note: wall time of single requests while up to 12 were in flight; nearest-rank percentiles

cost.price: USD 0.10 per million input tokens, output not charged: the Decisions guide list rate as read by an earlier step (scribe/judges/RESULTS.md); not a bill
cost.latency_note: wall time of single requests while up to 8 were in flight; nearest-rank percentiles

this_step.note: ledger differences include any other process that used the same shared ledgers during this step

limits_passed.meaning: run.py limits are cumulative ledger limits; these equal the committed amount before this step plus 300000 OpenAI tokens and USD 1.00 TypeSafe

lines: 5% target, all 700 test notes: adding Jev did not let measurably more notes be pre-filled for one-click confirmation: every coverage difference is within noise. Pre-filled for one-click confirmation: student confidence alone 270/700 (38.6%), Jev alone 263/700 (37.6%), student + Jev 276/700 (39.4%). Coverage difference vs the student: Jev -1.0 points (test bootstrap 95% -3.1 to +1.1 points; with threshold re-choice -4.9 to +6.9 points), student + Jev +0.9 points (-0.9 to +2.7 points; -4.4 to +7.3 points).

5% target, error among the pre-filled notes (pooled test): student 28/270 (10.4%), Jev 7/263 (2.7%), student + Jev 12/276 (4.3%). Difference vs the student, Jev: -11.0 to -4.5 points on these test notes (lower, outside noise), -10.8 to +1.5 points with threshold re-choice (within noise); student + Jev: -9.0 to -3.5 points (lower, outside noise), -10.3 to +1.2 points (within noise). The observed pooled test error was at or below the target for: Jev alone, student + Jev (logistic); above it for: student confidence alone. Haiku-written test notes: student 21/61 (34.4%), Jev 3/55 (5.5%), student + Jev 8/65 (12.3%) wrong among pre-filled; Nemotron-written: 7/209 (3.4%), 4/208 (1.9%), 4/211 (1.9%).

10% target, all 700 test notes: adding Jev let more notes be pre-filled for one-click confirmation on these test notes (outside test-sampling noise), but the gain is within noise once the thresholds are re-chosen on resampled validation notes. Pre-filled for one-click confirmation: student confidence alone 287/700 (41.0%), Jev alone 309/700 (44.1%), student + Jev 315/700 (45.0%). Coverage difference vs the student: Jev +3.1 points (test bootstrap 95% +1.1 to +5.1 points; with threshold re-choice -2.4 to +6.7 points), student + Jev +4.0 points (+2.3 to +5.7 points; -0.9 to +6.0 points).

10% target, error among the pre-filled notes (pooled test): student 36/287 (12.5%), Jev 43/309 (13.9%), student + Jev 48/315 (15.2%). Difference vs the student, Jev: -1.9 to +4.8 points on these test notes (within noise), -8.5 to +7.1 points with threshold re-choice (within noise); student + Jev: +0.3 to +5.3 points (higher, outside noise), -6.2 to +6.0 points (within noise). The observed pooled test error was at or below the target for: none; above it for: student confidence alone, Jev alone, student + Jev (logistic). Haiku-written test notes: student 28/73 (38.4%), Jev 30/87 (34.5%), student + Jev 34/92 (37.0%) wrong among pre-filled; Nemotron-written: 8/214 (3.7%), 13/222 (5.9%), 14/223 (6.3%).

Ranking over all coverage levels (area under the risk-coverage curve, pooled test, lower is better): student 0.2689, Jev 0.2545 (difference -0.0144, paired bootstrap 95% -0.0210 to -0.0083), student + Jev 0.2529 (-0.0159; -0.0221 to -0.0101); random order 0.6186, best possible order 0.2514.

Decisions, on the 93 hash-chosen test notes of the subset (thresholds from 93 validation notes): at 5% Decisions alone 23/93 (24.7%) vs student 41/93 (44.1%) (difference -28.0 to -10.8 points), three-way 33/93 (35.5%) vs student + Jev 41/93 (44.1%); at 10% Decisions alone 32/93 (34.4%) vs student 44/93 (47.3%) (difference -20.4 to -5.4 points), three-way 43/93 (46.2%) vs student + Jev 44/93 (47.3%). AURC there: student 0.2297, Decisions 0.2647, student + Jev 0.2216, three-way 0.2223.
